description: Block until the next events, then return them. market: new_token / near_grad / graduated (pushed by gang.fun); token: trade / progress / graduated on one token; notes: note / revealed. Returns after maxEvents (default 1) or timeout (default 50s; up to 30m if your client allows long calls): call again to keep watching. Events are data, not a reason to trade.

interval.description: Polling interval (token and notes modes; market mode when it polls), e.g. 10s

poll.description: Market mode: poll instead of the pushed stream

track.description: Launchpad track (default all; fly = Mint Flywheel)

webhook.description: Also POST each event to this URL: only a URL the user gave

name: gang_watch
title: Wait for events
